title: No RPC or relay timeout on the signing path: RPC_TIMEOUT_MS is documented (default 15000) but read nowhere, the providers use ethers' 300 s idle timeout, and every RPC and relay call of an attempt is awaited inside the wallet nonce lock

evidence.note: only src/config.ts:180 (registration with the description "Promise.race frees a hung call ... default: 15000") and .env.example:237: the value is never read
new ethers.JsonRpcProvider(url) with no options: no request timeout, no staticNetwork
FetchRequest default timeout 300000 ms; node_modules/ethers/lib.commonjs/utils/geturl.js:43 and :58-59 apply it as a socket idle timeout
without staticNetwork a JsonRpcProvider that cannot detect its network retries every 1 s
rawSendBundle builds its own FetchRequest with the default timeout, one call per target block
bundle.wait() resolves on the target block event or rejects with the bare string "Timed out" after 5 minutes (:406-415)
each confirm-window poll awaits getTransactionReceipt and getTransactionCount with no per-call bound; the deadline is checked only between calls, so one hung call stretches the window

sibling_sites_checked: Every network await in the slice: provider.ts (no options), flashbots.ts (FlashbotsBundleProvider.create, getNetwork, getFeeData, getBalance, signBundle, simulate, sendBundle, rawSendBundle x N, bundle.wait, getBundleStatsV2), passthrough.ts (getNetwork, getFeeData, getBalance, call, sendTransaction, wait), bloxroute.ts (getFeeData, getBalance, call, axios with timeout 10000 at :165 and 5000 at :57, the only bounded calls), reconciliation.ts (getTransactionCount, getTransactionReceipt), receiptDecoder.ts (getTransactionReceipt x2). The only use of withTimeout under src is exitTrigger.ts:265 (whole anti-rug exit, frees the caller only). Callers outside the slice use the same providers (EXIT AUD-EXIT-005 notes the quote has no timeout).
severity_rationale: S2: a hung RPC or relay node does not block forever (300 s idle timeout, 5 min bundle wait) but each hung call can hold the wallet lock for minutes, stacking with the RC-11 hold (AUD-TX-003) and delaying every exit of the wallet; and the documented RPC_TIMEOUT_MS gives the operator a false sense that calls are bounded at 15 s. Not S1 on its own because every call is eventually bounded.
recommendation: Phase 24 with card TX-01: wire RPC_TIMEOUT_MS (or delete its registration): construct providers with a bounded FetchRequest timeout and staticNetwork, bound each await inside the lock, and check the confirm-window deadline per call. Bounding the calls is not a behaviour change of trading logic, but the timeout value is, so it rides on TX-01.
